notes.title: Murder time! Danganronpa V3 PC release confirmed
notes.notes: That rapscallion robot bear Monokuma is at it again, imprisoning more schoolchildren in a school and forcing them to play a life-and-death game of murder and mystery-solving in Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony [official site]. Developers Spike Chunsoft have now confirmed that yup, the next in their adventure-o-visual novel will indeed be coming to PC too. While past Danganronpa PC versions have followed a while after their western console releases, this one will arrive on the very same day: September 26th. Peep this trailer: … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]9/2/2016
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We released a patch on August 30, 2016 that addresses the following issues:

All Platforms
[list]
     [*]Changed the graphic used in the launcher for Japanese and Chinese.
     [*]Fixed issues where a different button or key is shown in the tutorial or the help menu.
     [*]Fixed issues where some of the texts are cut-off in Japanese and Chinese.
     [*]Fixed issues where a corrupt text is shown in Japanese and Chinese.
     [*]Various minor fixes and improvements.
[/list] 

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: [Japanese/Traditional Chinese Language]Patch
notes.notes:
We have released a Japanese and Traditional Chinese language patch for Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc and Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair

To change languages,
1.	Launch Steam.
2.	Go to [Library]
3.	Right click on [Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc] or [Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair] and select [Properties].
4.	Go to the [Language] tab.
5.	Select [Japanese] or [Traditional Chinese].

Please note that save data is not compatible between languages. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.
